name: the-loot-box-vault
description: A Dungeon Crawler Carl fan collectors site: track merch and cards, open loot boxes, share your vault.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-loot-box-vault "vitest run --project rules --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=test-results/rules-junit.xml"
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-loot-box-vault "node scripts/seed.mjs && playwright test"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes
